note: The bar for approval, as a rate from 0 to 1. For inaccurate, the rate must be at most the bar. For all others, at least the bar.

why.protocol: The main measure. A small model makes small mistakes. Below this bar, the mistakes get in the way of the practice.
why.facts_given: A student who asks the right question must get the answer. Below this bar, good students lose marks because of the model.
why.denials: The patient must not invent a symptom. An invented symptom can lead a student to a wrong diagnosis.
why.open_no_leak: Hidden facts test the student's questions. An open question such as "anything else?" must not give them away.
why.inaccurate: A reply that goes against the case teaches a wrong fact. This is the most serious mistake, so it has the strictest bar.
why.checklist: A good question in normal words must get credit.
why.checklist_reach: Every checklist item must be possible to earn.
why.exams: An examination typed in normal words must find the correct result.
why.correct_notes: A correct note must always pass.
why.wrong_notes: A note with a wrong diagnosis must always fail.
why.dx_words: The correct diagnosis, written in different words, must get credit.
